title: Psalm 108: An Old Song Sung Again
summary: The psalmist wakes the dawn with music and praises God among the nations for a love higher than the heavens. He then recalls an old oracle in which God claims the land of Israel and its hostile neighbors as his own, and asks who will lead the army into Edom. The psalm ends with a confession that human help is worthless and a confident hope that God will win the battle.
line: An old song sung again: the psalmist wakes the dawn with music, recalls an old word from God, and confesses that human help is worthless and God will win the battle.
guide: A steadfast heart is not the same as calm circumstances; in Psalm 57 the same words came from a cave. You may borrow old prayers for your own day; a prayer learned long ago may be exactly the one you need now.

stanzas.title: A steadfast heart wakes the dawn
Praise among the nations for love beyond the heavens
God's oracle: the land and the nations are his
Who will lead us? Has God rejected us?
Human help fails; with God we will prevail

verses.t: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
